representation_contract.full_blob_reconstructibility: Every base unit carries repository + immutable commit + path; exact source text is recoverable from the frozen blob at that locator.
representation_contract.semantic_split_rule: High-risk mixed-standing, historical/current, execution/result, manipulation/outcome, practical/significance, and estimator/intrinsic boundaries receive separate source-local units.
representation_contract.independence_rule: Multiple units at one source location are not independent sources or warrants.
representation_contract.absence_rule: not extracted != does not exist outside aperture
representation_contract.base_unit_materialization: R39-U0001..R39-U0163 are deterministic one-to-one projections of source_surface.admitted_paths in frozen order; shards 01-02 freeze the index ranges and classification rules rather than redundantly copying every path.
